821: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਏ ਪੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸਨੁ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਤ ॥
Beholding the Lord, the saints are fully sated of craving for Maya; they ever eat the delicious, life-giving food of the Lord's Name.
ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਤ ॥੨॥੪॥੮੪॥
Nanak, say: O Lord, those who take the refuge of Your feet, You in Your mercy unite with the company of the saints. ॥2॥4॥84॥
The Lord has ever Himself protected His servants.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨੋ; ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In His mercy He has given them the gift of His Name, and all their worries and torments are destroyed. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ; ਰਾਗ ਰਤਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਆਲਾਪ ॥
O saints, join together and sing the praises of the Lord of the universe; utter His virtues with your tongues through jewel-like ragas.
ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨਿਵਰੀ ਰਾਮ; ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਆਤਮ ਧ੍ਰਾਪ ॥੧॥
The craving of millions of lives is removed in those who utter His praise, and through the Name, the supreme elixir, their souls are sated. ॥1॥
ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ. ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪ ॥
Those who hold fast to the feet of the Lord, Giver of comforts, stay in His refuge, and through the Guru's teaching repeat His Name,
ਸਾਗਰ ਤਰੇ. ਭਰਮ ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ; ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥੨॥੫॥੮੫॥
cross the world-ocean, and all their fears and doubts are destroyed. Nanak says: all this is the Master's glory. ॥2॥5॥85॥
The Guru, the Creator Himself, has brought down the child Hargobind's fever.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੀ ਸਾਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I am ever a sacrifice to my True Guru, who has kept my honour before the whole world, while the superstitious kept urging the worship of the smallpox goddess and the like. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿ; ਬਾਲਿਕੁ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਨੋ ॥
Placing His hand on the child's head, God saved him from the fever.
ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ; ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਦੀਨੋ ॥੧॥
God has also given him His Name, life-giving and the supreme relish of all. ॥1॥
The merciful Lord surely keeps His servant's honour; so do not panic in pain and trouble and seek other supports.
Remember: Guru Nanak speaks only what is accepted in the Lord's court. ॥2॥6॥86॥
ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੭ ॥
Bilaval · Chaupade Dupade · Guru Arjan · Ghar 7
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
In the mind-temple where the lamp of the Guru's Word brings the light of spiritual life,
ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਤਿਹ ਮੰਦਰਿ; ਰਤਨ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਖੁਲੑੀ ਅਨੂਪਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the beautiful chamber of the jewels of virtue opens, and the darkness of low living is destroyed there. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਏ ਜਉ ਪੇਖਿਓ; ਕਹਨੁ. ਨ ਜਾਇ, ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
When, in the light of that lamp, one beholds the Lord dwelling within, all sense of mine and yours is forgotten in wonder; the greatness of that state cannot be told.
ਮਗਨ ਭਏ ਊਹਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਤੇ; ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਲਪਟਾਈ ॥੧॥
As warp and weft are woven together, so the attention is immersed in Him, intoxicated at His feet, and clings to them. ॥1॥
ਆਲ ਜਾਲ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੂ ਜੰਜਾਰਾ; ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਨਹੀ ਭੋਰਾ ॥
In that state the nets and entanglements of household attachment are not even felt, and not a particle of the intellect that says "I, I" remains.
ਊਚਨ ਊਚਾ. ਬੀਚੁ, ਨ ਖੀਚਾ; ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ. ਤੂੰ ਮੋਰਾ ॥੨॥
Then the Highest of the high alone is seen dwelling in the mind-temple, with no curtain drawn between; one says to Him: I am Your servant, You are my Master. ॥2॥
ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ; ਏਕੈ ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
Then, outside too, the one all-pervading, infinite Lord alone is seen spread out as the world.
ਏਕੁ ਬਿਸਥੀਰਨੁ. ਏਕੁ ਸੰਪੂਰਨੁ; ਏਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
He alone seems spread everywhere, pervading all, and He alone is seen as the support of the life of beings. ॥3॥
ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ, ਸੂਚਾ ਸੂਚੋ; ਸੂਚਾ ਸੂਚੋ ਸੂਚਾ ॥
Then it is plainly seen that the Lord is supremely pure, supremely holy, holy, holy, holy.
ਅੰਤ ਨ ਅੰਤਾ, ਸਦਾ ਬੇਅੰਤਾ; ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੮੭॥
Nanak says: His end can never be found; He is ever infinite, the Highest of the high. ॥4॥1॥87॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ; ਕਾਮਿ. ਨ ਆਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
Apart from the Lord's Name nothing is of use to your spiritual life.
ਜਾ ਸਿਉ ਰਾਚਿ ਮਾਚਿ ਤੁਮੑ ਲਾਗੇ; ਓਹ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮੋਹਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The enchanting Maya with which you are entangled is deceiving you. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕਨਿਕ ਕਾਮਿਨੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੋਹਨੀ; ਛੋਡਿ ਖਿਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
Gold and wealth, a woman's beautiful bed: a person leaves all these in an instant and departs.
ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਿਓ; ਬਿਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਖਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
Driven by the pleasures of the senses you are caught in lust and eating the drugging herb of vice, which leaves you senseless to spiritual life. ॥1॥
ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਓ; ਪਾਵਕੁ ਤਲੈ ਜਰਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
Having built and adorned a house of straw, you light a fire beneath it: kindling the blaze of lust and the rest in this body, you are burning your spiritual life to ash.
ਐਸੇ ਗੜ ਮਹਿ. ਐਠਿ ਹਠੀਲੋ; ਫੂਲਿ ਫੂਲਿ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
Sitting stubborn and swollen with pride in this burning body-fortress, what are you gaining by your pride? Nothing at all. ॥2॥
ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤ. ਮੂਡ ਪਰਿ ਠਾਢੇ; ਕੇਸ ਗਹੇ ਫੇਰਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
O blind, ignorant one, the five enemies, lust and the rest, stand over your head, dragging you about by the hair and disgracing you,
822: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ. ਨ ਆਵਹਿ, ਅੰਧ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ; ਸੋਇ ਰਹਿਓ ਮਦ ਮਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
but you do not see them; drunk on vice, you lie asleep, careless of spiritual life. ॥3॥
ਜਾਲੁ ਪਸਾਰਿ ਚੋਗ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੀ; ਪੰਖੀ ਜਿਉ ਫਾਹਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
As a net is spread and bait scattered to catch a bird, so you are being trapped in the bait of the world's things.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਨ ਕਉ; ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਵਤ ਹੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੮੮॥
Nanak says: to cut the bonds of Maya, I keep the Guru, the great Being, enshrined in my heart. ॥4॥2॥88॥
The Name of the infinite Lord cannot be had in exchange for any worldly thing.
ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪਿਆਰੋ. ਮਨਹਿ ਅਧਾਰੋ; ਚੀਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਨ ਤੰਬੋਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
That Name has become dear to my life and the support of my mind; as a betel-seller cares for her betel leaves, so I keep the Lord's Name in my thoughts. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਬਤਾਇਓ; ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਚੋਲੀ ॥
When the Guru told me the secret, I merged in spiritual poise; now the blouse of my body is dyed in the Lord's love.
ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਮੁਖਿ. ਲਾਗੋ ਜਉ ਵਡਭਾਗੋ; ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਕਤਹੁ. ਨ ਡੋਲੀ ॥੧॥
Since my great fortune awoke by the Guru's grace, I behold my Beloved's face; now my wedded state will never waver. ॥1॥
ਰੂਪ ਨ ਧੂਪ. ਨ ਗੰਧ, ਨ ਦੀਪਾ; ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ, ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਉਲੀ ॥
I offered my Husband no lovely things, no incense, no perfumes, no lamps; by the Guru's grace my whole being has become one with Him, and meeting Him my mind has blossomed.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਰਵੀ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ; ਅਤਿ ਨੀਕੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਬਨੀ ਖਟੋਲੀ ॥੨॥੩॥੮੯॥
Nanak says: the beloved Lord has made me His wedded bride and united me with Himself, and the bed of my heart has become most beautiful. ॥2॥3॥89॥
Remembering the Lord of the universe ever and again, a person becomes the very form of the Lord.
ਜਬ ਤੇ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧ ਦਇਆਰਾ; ਤਬ ਤੇ. ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਭਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
From the day one meets the merciful Guru, evil thinking is removed from within. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਪੂਰਨ. ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ; ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ. ਦਇਆਲ ਦਈ ॥
Meeting the Guru, one becomes sure that the beloved Lord, embodiment of mercy and peace, full of all virtues, pervades everywhere.
ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਾ; ਤਨ ਤੇ ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲ ਖਈ ॥੧॥
Through remembrance, lust, anger, craving, pride and all the vices are destroyed in that person's body. ॥1॥
ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਸੁਚਿ; ਸੰਤਨ ਤੇ. ਇਹੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਲਈ ॥
Meeting the Guru, one receives from the saints this teaching: to cultivate service, contentment, compassion, righteousness and a pure life.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨਹੁ ਪਛਾਨਿਆ; ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਗਲੀ ਸੋਝ ਪਈ ॥੨॥੪॥੯੦॥
Nanak says: those who formed kinship with the Guru through their own minds gained full understanding of the lofty spiritual life. ॥2॥4॥90॥
ਕਿਆ ਹਮ. ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਬੇਚਾਰੇ; ਬਰਨਿ. ਨ ਸਾਕਹ, ਏਕ ਰੋਮਾਈ ॥
O my Master, what are we poor beings? We cannot describe even one hair's worth of You.
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਹੇਸ ਸਿਧ ਮੁਨਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾ; ਬੇਅੰਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ. ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ, ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
Brahma, Shiva, adepts, sages and Indra, countless as they are, could not understand what You are like, O infinite Master. ॥1॥
ਕਿਆ ਕਥੀਐ; ਕਿਛੁ ਕਥਨੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
What can one say of what the Lord is like? It cannot be told.
ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ; ਤਹ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Wherever I look, the Lord is present everywhere. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜਹ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਦੂਖ ਜਮ ਸੁਨੀਐ; ਤਹ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
O my God, where one hears that Death's most dreadful pains are suffered, there You alone are the helper who saves.
ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਗਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੨॥੫॥੯੧॥
O God, the Guru has given Nanak this understanding; so I, Nanak, have come to Your refuge and taken hold of Your feet. ॥2॥5॥91॥
ਅਗਮ ਰੂਪ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਕਰਤਾ; ਪਤਿਤ. ਪਵਿਤ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਜਪਾਈਐ ॥
Remember at every moment the imperishable Creator, unreachable in form, who purifies sinners.
ਅਚਰਜੁ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਭੇਟੁਲੇ; ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ ਚਰਨ. ਮਨੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
It is heard that He is wondrous, and that union with Him comes when one meets the feet of the saints; so fix your mind on the saints' feet. ॥1॥
By what method, by what discipline, can He be found?
ਕਹੁ ਸੁਰਜਨ; ਕਿਤੁ ਜੁਗਤੀ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O good soul, tell me: in what way should the Lord be remembered? ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜੋ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ. ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ; ਓਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਲਈ ਲਈ, ਫੁਨਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
O Lord, when one person serves another, the one served ever remembers that service again and again; how much more do You.
ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ; ਮੋਹਿ ਟੇਕ ਤੇਰੋ ਇਕ ਨਾਈਐ ॥੨॥੬॥੯੨॥
Nanak, say: O Lord, ocean of comfort, I will ever stay in Your refuge, in Your refuge; I have the support of Your Name alone. ॥2॥6॥92॥
When I took the Guru's refuge and began to serve the Guru,
ਧੰਧੁ ਬੰਧੁ ਅਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਜੰਜਾਰੋ; ਅਵਰ ਕਾਜ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਿ ਪਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
worldly business, bondage and every entanglement ended within me, and my mind was freed from other pursuits. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਰੁ ਘਨੋ ਅਨੰਦਾ; ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਇਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ॥
From the Guru I received the Lord's Name, and through it the comfort of poise and great bliss arose within me.
823: ਐਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਬਰਨਿ. ਨ ਸਾਕਉ; ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ. ਮੇਰੀ ਉਲਟਿ ਧਰੀ ॥੧॥
Such a relish of the Lord's Name came to me that I cannot describe it; the perfect Guru turned my mind back from Maya. ॥1॥
ਪੇਖਿਓ ਮੋਹਨੁ ਸਭ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ; ਊਨ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ. ਸਗਲ ਭਰੀ ॥
By the Guru's grace I have seen the beautiful Lord dwelling in all; no place is empty of Him, and all creation is full of His life.
ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ; ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਰੀ ॥੨॥੭॥੯੩॥
The Lord, treasure of mercy, is seen pervading everywhere in fullness. Nanak says: my labour has borne fruit. ॥2॥7॥93॥
ਮਨ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਤਾ; ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਤਾ ॥
O mind, what are you saying? O soul, what do you say?
ਜਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ; ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My Master, God, knows and understands every heart; no deceitful word can be spoken before Him. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਅਨਬੋਲੇ ਕਉ. ਤੁਹੀ ਪਛਾਨਹਿ; ਜੋ ਜੀਅਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਤਾ ॥
O Lord, whatever is in our hearts, You recognise even unspoken.
ਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਾਇ, ਕਹਾ ਲਉ ਡਹਕਹਿ; ਜਉ ਪੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਨਤਾ ॥੧॥
O mind, why do you deceive, and how long will you go on? The Lord, dwelling with you, sees and hears your deeds. ॥1॥
ਐਸੋ ਜਾਨਿ ਭਏ ਮਨਿ ਆਨਦ; ਆਨ. ਨ ਬੀਓ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
Knowing that no other but the Lord can do anything, joy arises in the mind.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਰਾ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ. ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਲਹਤਾ ॥੨॥੮॥੯੪॥
Nanak says: in the one on whom the Guru is merciful, the colour of the Lord's love never fades. ॥2॥8॥94॥
The slanderer falls from spiritual height just so;
ਇਹ ਨੀਸਾਨੀ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਈ; ਜਿਉ ਕਾਲਰ ਭੀਤਿ ਗਿਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
hear this sign, brother: as a wall of saltpetre crumbles and falls, so is the slanderer's life, for slander is like saltpetre to his spiritual life. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜਉ ਦੇਖੈ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੁ. ਤਉ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਉਮਾਹੈ; ਭਲੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੁਖ ਭਰੀਐ ॥
When the slanderer sees a fault in someone he is delighted, but seeing goodness he is filled with pain.
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਚਿਤਵੈ. ਨਹੀ ਪਹੁਚੈ; ਬੁਰਾ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਮਰੀਐ ॥੧॥
At all hours he plots to harm others, yet cannot reach the point of doing it, and dies a spiritual death just plotting harm. ॥1॥
ਨਿੰਦਕੁ. ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ. ਕਾਲੁ ਨੇਰੈ ਆਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਬਾਦੁ ਉਠਰੀਐ ॥
The more the Lord lets the slanderer stray into slander, the nearer his full spiritual death comes, and he keeps raising strife with the Lord's servants.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ. ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਕਿਆ ਮਾਨਸ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕਰੀਐ ॥੨॥੯॥੯੫॥
But, Nanak, the Master, God, is Himself the protector of His servants; what can poor mortals do to them? ॥2॥9॥95॥
Why do beings go astray like this?
ਕਰਹਿ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ. ਮੂਕਰਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਪੇਖਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
They commit evil deeds and have them done, then deny them; but the Lord, ever dwelling with all, sees and hears it all. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕਾਚ ਬਿਹਾਝਨ, ਕੰਚਨ ਛਾਡਨ; ਬੈਰੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਹੇਤੁ. ਸਾਜਨ ਤਿਆਗਿ. ਖਰੇ ॥
Trading in glass and throwing away gold, loving the enemy and forsaking the true friend: such are the deeds of beings.
ਹੋਵਨੁ ਕਉਰਾ. ਅਨਹੋਵਨੁ ਮੀਠਾ; ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਇ ਜਰੇ ॥੧॥
The Lord, who is, tastes bitter to them, and Maya, which will not remain, tastes sweet; entangled in Maya, they ever burn. ॥1॥
ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਪਰਾਨੀ; ਭਰਮ ਗੁਬਾਰ ਮੋਹ ਬੰਧਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
The mortal has fallen into the blind well of attachment, ever wandering, caught in the dark bonds of attachment.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹੋਤ ਦਇਆਰਾ; ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਕਾਢੈ ਬਾਹ. ਫਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੯੬॥
Nanak says: the one on whom the Lord is merciful meets the Guru, and the Guru takes him by the arm and draws him out of the dark well. ॥2॥10॥96॥
My mind, my body and my tongue have formed kinship with the Lord.
ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦਾ. ਮਿਟੇ ਅੰਦੇਸੇ; ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੑਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My Guru has given me every comfort; my worries have been wiped away and bliss upon bliss has arisen within me. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਇਆਨਪ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਭਈ ਸਿਆਨਪ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਦਾਨਾ ਬੀਨਾ ॥
In place of ignorance, wisdom has arisen in me, for by the Guru's grace I am sure that my Lord knows all hearts and sees all deeds.
ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੈ. ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ; ਕਾਹੂ ਨ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਖੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
I am sure that the Lord Himself saves His servant, giving him His hand, and no one can harm him at all. ॥1॥
ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵਉ ਦਰਸਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ; ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
I am a sacrifice to the sight of the Guru, by whose grace I have repeated the Lord's Name.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਰੋਸੈ; ਕਹੂ. ਨ ਮਾਨਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਛੀਨਾ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੯੭॥
Nanak says: relying on the Master, I do not accept in my mind any other support even for a moment. ॥2॥11॥97॥
The perfect Guru has saved my honour against the vices.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਨੋ; ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He has placed the life-giving Name in my heart, and the filth of the deeds of many lives has left my mind. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਨਿਵਰੇ ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਟ ਬੈਰਾਈ; ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਾ ਜਪਿਆ ਜਾਪੁ ॥
Since I began repeating the Name the perfect Guru taught, all the wicked enemies, lust and the rest, have fled.
824: ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈ ਕੋਈ ਬੇਚਾਰਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਾ ਬਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
My Lord's power is great; now none of them can do me any harm. ॥1॥
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
By the Guru's grace the Lord's beautiful feet have become my mind's support; remembering His Name at all times, I have found spiritual bliss.
ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ. ਪਰਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ; ਜਾ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੯੮॥
Servant Nanak has taken the refuge of the Lord above whom there is none. ॥2॥12॥98॥
Ever and ever repeat the Lord's Name.
ਜਰਾ ਮਰਾ ਕਛੁ ਦੂਖੁ. ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ; ਆਗੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through the Name such a lofty spiritual state is reached that old age, death and pain cannot touch it, and in the Lord's court hereafter too all affairs succeed. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਪਰੀਐ ਨਿਤ ਸਰਨੀ; ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
But this treasure of the Name comes only from the Guru; giving up self-conceit, stay ever in the Guru's refuge.
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ ਫਾਸੀ; ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਾ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
This Name is the pass to the presence of the eternal Lord, and through it the noose of birth and death is cut. ॥1॥
ਜੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਉ; ਮਨ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ਸਗਲ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
O Lord, if I receive Your Name I will accept as good whatever You do; through Your Name all pride leaves the mind.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੯੯॥
Nanak says: stay in the refuge of the Lord who created the whole world. ॥2॥13॥99॥
The one in whose mind and heart the Lord ever dwells,
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ. ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਨਿਤ; ਤਿਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਾ ਮੋਲੁ. ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
singing the Lord's praises and ever speaking of the good of others, has a tongue beyond price. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹ ਉਧਰੇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਹੀ ॥
The devotees who remember Him wash away the filth of the deeds of many lives, and all their family lines are saved in an instant.
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ. ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ; ਅਨਦ ਸੇਤੀ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਨੁ ਗਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
Remembering their Master, God, again and again, those devotees cross the forest of Maya in bliss. ॥1॥
ਚਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੇ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਪਾਏ; ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਹੀ ॥
Those who obtain the ship of the Lord's feet cross the world-ocean.
ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੇ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਹੈ ਤਾਹੀ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੧੦੦॥
Nanak: they alone are His saints, devotees and servants, and their minds stay ever fixed on Him. ॥2॥14॥100॥
O Lord, beholding Your wondrous plays, I take heart that You will help me too.
ਤੁਹੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ; ਤੂਹੀ ਵਸਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You are our Master and the Knower of our hearts; You dwell with every holy person. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਨੀਚ ਕੀਟ ਤੇ. ਕਰਹਿ ਰਾਜੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
O Master, You make kings of lowly worms; in an instant You bless the lowly and give them honour. ॥1॥
ਕਬਹੂ. ਨ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਹੀਏ ਮੋਰੇ ਤੇ; ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਇਹੀ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੰਗਾ ॥੨॥੧੫॥੧੦੧॥
Servant Nanak, pray: O Lord, be merciful, that Your Name may never be forgotten from my heart; this is the alms I beg at Your door. ॥2॥15॥101॥
The imperishable Sustainer of the earth alone is worthy of worship.
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਰਖਉ ਹਰਿ ਆਗੈ; ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I offer my mind and body and place them before that Lord; He is the Sustainer of all beings. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸਰਨਿ ਸਮ੍ਰਥ ਅਕਥ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਿੰਧੁ. ਬਡੋ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
The Lord is able to protect those in His refuge; His form cannot be described; He is the Giver of all comforts, the ocean of mercy, most compassionate.
ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ; ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਗੈ ਨ. ਤਾਤੀ ਬਾਲ ॥੧॥
He holds His servant close to His heart, and then not even a hot wind of affliction can touch him. ॥1॥
ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬਸੁ; ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਧਨ ਮਾਲ ॥
The Lord is the home of mercy and the Master of all; for His saints He is wealth, riches and everything.
ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਚਿਕ. ਦਰਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਗੈ; ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੧੦੨॥
Nanak, a beggar at His door, begs for the gift of His sight and prays that he may receive the dust of His saints' feet. ॥2॥16॥102॥
Remembering the Lord's Name, it is as if millions of efforts, pilgrimages and rituals were performed.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ; ਜਮਦੂਤਨ ਕਉ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਅਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The one who, joining the Guru's company, began to sing the Lord's praises, Death's messengers fear to approach. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜੇਤੇ ਪੁਨਹਚਰਨ ਸੇ ਕੀਨੑੇ; ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ ॥
The one who has enshrined the Lord's feet in mind and heart has, as it were, performed all the rites of atonement for past deeds.
ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਨਾਠਾ; ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦਹੇ ॥੧॥
His comings and goings ended, every doubt and fear fled, and the sins of many lives were burnt away. ॥1॥
ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ਭਜਹੁ ਜਗਦੀਸੈ; ਏਹੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਲਹੇ ॥
So, fearless and free of the doubts of ritual, remember the Master of the world; this treasure of the Name is found only by great fortune.
825: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ; ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਕਹੇ ॥੨॥੧੭॥੧੦੩॥
O all-pervading Giver, God, be merciful, that Your servant Nanak may keep singing Your purifying praise. ॥2॥17॥103॥
O Lord, Your servant's prayer to You was: save us from Sulhi Khan,
ਸੁਲਹੀ ਕਾ ਹਾਥੁ ਕਹੀ. ਨ ਪਹੁਚੈ; ਸੁਲਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਮੂਆ ਨਾਪਾਕੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and let Sulhi's cruel hand reach us nowhere. By the Lord's own mercy, Sulhi has died with a defiled mind. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕਾਢਿ ਕੁਠਾਰੁ ਖਸਮਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਕਾਟਿਆ; ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਆ ਹੈ ਖਾਕੁ ॥
The Master drew the axe of death and cut off Sulhi's head, and in an instant he became a heap of ashes.
ਮੰਦਾ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਪਚਿਆ; ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਧਾਕੁ ॥੧॥
Plotting harm to others again and again, Sulhi burned himself up; the Lord who created him pushed him on toward the next world. ॥1॥
ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਮੀਤ ਧਨੁ ਕਿਛੂ. ਨ ਰਹਿਓ; ਸੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਇਆ ਸਭ ਭਾਈ ਸਾਕੁ ॥
Sulhi left this world, leaving all his family behind; for him no son, no friend, no wealth, nothing at all remained.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ; ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਕੀਨੋ ਪੂਰਨ ਵਾਕੁ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੧੦੪॥
Nanak says: I am a sacrifice to that Lord who heard His servant's prayer and saved him from Sulhi. ॥2॥18॥104॥
The support of the perfect Guru makes life fruitful.
ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਕਾਰਜੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਕੀਆ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Guru has ever accomplished every affair of the Sikh in his refuge, and by his grace one becomes sure that the Master Himself is present everywhere. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਅਪਨਾ ਥਾਟੁ ਬਨਾਇਓ ਆਪਿ ॥
The Guru instils the faith that the Master who made this play of the world is eternal: at its beginning, now, and at its end.
ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੈ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕੋ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
From the Guru comes the certainty that the Lord's power is great and that He Himself ever keeps His servant's honour. ॥1॥
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ; ਵਸਿ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਜੰਤ ॥
The Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Master, who holds all beings in His power,
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਈ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੧੦੫॥
Nanak, stay in the refuge of His beautiful feet and of the Guru; repeating the Lord's Name-mantra in the Guru's refuge, one becomes pure of life. ॥2॥19॥105॥
The Lord Himself saves from fevers and sins
ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਾਗੇ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
those who fall at the Guru's feet and repeat the Lord's Name in their hearts; their hearts become cool and calm. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਸਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੀਨੇ; ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ॥
On those who take the Guru's refuge and repeat the Name, God in His kindness has ever placed His hands; He carries the whole world across, and His glory shines through all nine regions.
ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ. ਸੁਖ ਅਨਦ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸਾ; ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ. ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸਚੁ ਧ੍ਰਾਪ ॥੧॥
For them all pain is destroyed and comfort and bliss enter their hearts; repeating the eternal Name their craving is quenched, and mind and body are satisfied. ॥1॥
ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥੁ. ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਰਥਾ; ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੋ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪੁ ॥
The Lord is the Master of the masterless, able to help those in His refuge, the mother and father of all creation.
ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਲਾਪ ॥੨॥੨੦॥੧੦੬॥
That Master loves devotion and destroys fear; Nanak, keep singing His praises and uttering His Name. ॥2॥20॥106॥
Ever keep kinship with the Lord from whom you were born.
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਹੋਏ ਕਲਿਆਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The one who has remembered the Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Master, has peace, comfort and bliss within. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਬਡ ਭਾਗੀ; ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥
Those fortunate ones who meet the perfect Guru, the Knower of every heart, beautiful and wise,
ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਅਪਨੇ; ਬਡ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਕੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
mighty, and the honour of the dishonoured, the Lord gives them His hand, makes them His own and keeps them safe from all fears and doubts. ॥1॥
ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਏ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਚਾਨਾਣੁ ॥
The one who remembers the Lord's Name has all fears and doubts destroyed in an instant, the darkness of attachment is dispelled, and the light of spiritual life shines.
ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਆਰਾਧੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੧੦੭॥
Nanak remembers that Lord with every breath; be ever a sacrifice to Him. ॥2॥21॥107॥
The one who, in the Guru's refuge, repeats the Lord's Name, the valiant Guru saves in both places, this world and the next.

ਜਨ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ. ਸੰਭਾਖਨੁ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ; ਊਠਨੁ ਬੈਠਨੁ. ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
I beg this gift from Your servants: that I may serve Your servants, speak with Your servants, and sit and rise in the company of Your servants.
ਜਨ ਚਰ ਰਜ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਥੈ ਲਾਗੀ; ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਨੰਤ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
May the dust of Your servants' feet touch my face and forehead; this dust stills the hopes that raise countless waves of Maya. ॥1॥
ਜਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ. ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮਹਿਮਾ; ਜਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਤੀਰਥ ਕੋਟਿ ਗੰਗਾ ॥
The servants of the Transcendent Lord are such that their glory is spotless; their feet are equal to millions of pilgrimage places like the Ganges.
ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ. ਕੀਓ ਮਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਹਰੇ ਕਲੰਗਾ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੨੦॥
Nanak: the one who has bathed in the dust of the feet of the Lord's servants has the sins of many lives removed. ॥2॥4॥120॥
O Lord, as You will, protect me from faults.
ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ; ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ. ਤੁਮੑ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Transcendent Lord, Supreme Master, True Guru, we beings are Your children, and You are our merciful, sustaining Father. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ. ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਈ; ਪਹੁਚਿ. ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਘਾਲ ॥
O Lord, I am without virtue, with no virtue at all; I cannot appreciate the labour You spend in sustaining us beings.
ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹੁ; ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰੋ ਮਾਲ ॥੧॥
O Lord, only You know what You are like and how great You are; our bodies and lives are all capital given by You. ॥1॥
ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਅਨਬੋਲਤ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਹਾਲ ॥
O Knower of every heart, all-pervading Master, You know our state without our speaking.
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਮਾਰੋ; ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੨੧॥
Nanak, say: O God, look on me with Your gracious glance, that my body and mind may become cool. ॥2॥5॥121॥
O God, keep us ever at Your feet.
ਤੂ ਹਮਰੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਨਮੋਹਨੁ; ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ. ਜੀਵਨੁ ਸਗਲ ਅਕਾਥ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You are our Beloved, the Enchanter of our minds; separated from You, our whole life is in vain. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਰੰਕ ਤੇ ਰਾਉ ਕਰਤ. ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੋ. ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥ ॥
My God is the Master of the masterless; in an instant He makes a pauper a king.
ਜਲਤ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਨ ਆਪਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ; ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਹਾਥ ॥੧॥
Those burning in the fire of craving He Himself saves, making them His servants; making them His own, He gives them His hand and protects them. ॥1॥
ਸੀਤਲ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਮਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸ੍ਰਮ ਸਗਲੇ ਲਾਥ ॥
Remembering the Lord's Name, the bliss that brings peace is found, the mind is sated of craving, and all toil and wandering after Maya end.
ਨਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ; ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਗਲ ਅਕਾਥ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੨੨॥
Nanak: service and devotion to the Lord is the treasure of all treasures; all other cleverness is worthless before it. ॥2॥6॥122॥
829: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ; ਕਬਹੁ. ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰਹੁ ॥
O my Master, never forget me, Your servant.
ਉਰਿ ਲਾਗਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ; ਪੂਰਬ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬੀਚਾਰਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O my Master God, dwell in my heart; O Lord of the universe, remember my love from of old. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਪਤਿਤ. ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੋ; ਹਮਰੇ ਦੋਖ ਰਿਦੈ ਮਤ ਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
O God, it is Your age-old nature to purify the fallen; do not keep my faults in Your heart.
ਜੀਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ; ਹਉਮੈ ਪਟਲੁ. ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਰਹੁ ॥੧॥
O Lord, You alone are my life and breath, my wealth and my comfort; in Your mercy burn away the veil of ego within me. ॥1॥
ਜਲ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਮੀਨ ਕਤ ਜੀਵਨ; ਦੂਧ ਬਿਨਾ. ਰਹਨੁ ਕਤ ਬਾਰੋ ॥
O my Master, a fish cannot live without water, and a child cannot live without milk;
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਆਸ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲਨੑ ਕੀ; ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੋ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੨੩॥
so servant Nanak thirsts for the sight of Your beautiful feet; beholding You, O Master, Your servant finds every comfort. ॥2॥7॥123॥
For that person there is comfort in this world and the next,
ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਸਭ ਰਾਖੀ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਮਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
on whom the Transcendent Lord God has shown mercy, and whose honour the perfect Guru has fully saved against the vices. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ; ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਸਗਲਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
In the mind and heart of the one whose honour the perfect Guru saves, the beloved Lord ever dwells, and all his pain and suffering are wiped away.
ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਆਨਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ; ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਿ ਹੋਏ ਖਇਆ ॥੧॥
He ever sings the Lord's praises, the bliss of peace and poise stays within him, and all his enemies, lust and the rest, are destroyed. ॥1॥
ਗੁਨੁ ਅਵਗੁਨੁ. ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਛੁ, ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
The Lord does not weigh that person's virtues and faults at all; in His mercy He makes him His own servant.
ਅਤੁਲ ਬਡਾਈ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ; ਨਾਨਕੁ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਜਇਆ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੨੪॥
The might of the unshakeable, imperishable Lord is beyond compare; Nanak ever utters the Lord's victory. ॥2॥8॥124॥
Without enshrining the Lord's fear and reverence in the mind and without devotion, how can one cross the world-ocean?
ਕਰਹੁ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ. ਪਤਿਤ, ਉਧਾਰਨ; ਰਾਖੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪ ਭਰੋਸੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Master, Saviour of sinners from sin, be merciful to me and keep me safe from these vices; I rely on You alone. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸਿਮਰਨੁ. ਨਹੀ ਆਵਤ. ਫਿਰਤ ਮਦ ਮਾਵਤ; ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਾਤਾ ਸੁਆਨ ਜੈਸੇ ॥
O Lord, without Your grace a being does not know how to remember You; he wanders drunk on Maya, roaming about dyed in Maya like a mad dog.
ਅਉਧ ਬਿਹਾਵਤ ਅਧਿਕ ਮੋਹਾਵਤ; ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵਤ ਬੁਡੇ ਐਸੇ ॥੧॥
O Lord, as life passes, beings are plundered more and more by the vices, and so, committing sin upon sin, they sink in the world-ocean. ॥1॥
ਸਰਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ. ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ; ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਵਣੁ ਜੈਸੇ ॥
O Destroyer of pain, all-pervading Lord beyond Maya's sway, be merciful, that by whatever means Your servant may keep remembering You in the holy congregation.
ਕੇਸਵ. ਕਲੇਸ ਨਾਸ ਅਘ ਖੰਡਨ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੀਵਤ ਦਰਸ ਦਿਸੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੧੨੫॥
Nanak, say: O Keshav, Destroyer of afflictions and sins, Your servant Nanak gains spiritual life only by beholding You. ॥2॥9॥125॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
O Lord, those who take Your refuge You unite with Your feet.
ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਆਏ; ਤਬ ਤੇ ਦੋਖ ਗਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
From the moment they come to Your refuge, all their sins are removed. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਚਿੰਤ ਬਿਰਾਨੀ; ਸਾਧਹ ਸਰਨ ਪਏ ॥
Those You join to Your feet give up pride and thoughts of hope in others and take the refuge of the saints,
ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਤਨ ਤੇ ਰੋਗ ਖਏ ॥੧॥
and, O Beloved, repeating Your Name again and again, all diseases are destroyed from their bodies. ॥1॥
ਮਹਾ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਜਾਨ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ; ਰਾਖੇ ਧਾਰਿ ਦਏ ॥
Even the greatest fools, the ignorant and the unknowing who take the saints' refuge by Your grace, You in Your mercy save from vices and diseases.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ; ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨ ਰਹੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੨੬॥
Nanak says: those who meet the perfect Guru have their comings and goings ended. ॥2॥1॥126॥
Hearing the Lord's Name, spiritual life arises within me,
ਜਉ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ; ਤਬ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੁਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
but this hope of mine to remember His Name is fulfilled only when the perfect Guru is well pleased with me. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਪੀਰ ਗਈ. ਬਾਧੀ ਮਨਿ ਧੀਰਾ; ਮੋਹਿਓ ਅਨਦ ਧੁਨੀ ॥
When, by the Guru's grace, I repeat the Name, the pain within me departs, my mind takes heart, and I am enraptured by the current of spiritual bliss within.
ਉਪਜਿਓ ਚਾਉ ਮਿਲਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ; ਰਹਨੁ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ਖਿਨੀ ॥੧॥
A longing to meet the beloved Lord arises within me, so strong that I cannot live even a moment without union. ॥1॥
830: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਗਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨ ਤਾਰੇ; ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਮੁਨੀ ॥
O Lord, countless sages remember Your Name, and countless devotees and servants who remember You, You have carried across the world-ocean.
ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਟਿਕ. ਨਿਰਧਨ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਗੁਨੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੨੭॥
Nanak, say: O Lord of countless virtues, through Your Name the blind man finds, as it were, a staff, and the pauper finds wealth. ॥2॥2॥127॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਮੋਹਨ. ਨੀਦ, ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਵੈ; ਹਾਰ ਕਜਰ, ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਭਰਨ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
O Enchanter-Lord, as a wife separated from her husband, though she wears necklaces, collyrium, fine clothes and ornaments, gets no sleep in her sighing,
and waiting for him stays ever forlorn, forlorn, forlorn,
and asks her friend: sister, when will he come home? So, O Enchanter, separated from You I find no peace. ॥1॥ Rahao
O Enchanter-Lord, I take the refuge of a wedded bride devoted to the Guru and, placing my head at her feet, ask:
Sister, unite me with my beautiful Beloved;
tell me, when will He come to the home of my heart? ॥1॥
ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਹੇਰੀ, ਮਿਲਨ ਬਾਤ ਕਹਉ; ਸਗਰੋ. ਅਹੰ ਮਿਟਾਵਹੁ; ਤਉ ਘਰ ਹੀ. ਲਾਲਨੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
The wedded bride says: listen, friend, I tell you how to meet Him: remove all your pride, and then you will find the Beloved within your own heart-home.
Then, beholding Him there, sing His praises that bring joy and bliss,
and remember the Lord who is bliss itself.
Sister, Nanak too has come to the Guru's door,
and coming there, I have found my beautiful Beloved within my heart-home. ॥2॥
Sister, now the Enchanter-Lord grants me His sight,
now the detachment from attachment to Maya seems sweet to me,
all my thirst for Maya is quenched,
now I am settled in spiritual poise,
and the talk of my Husband-Lord's praises is sweet to me.
ਮੋਹਨੁ ਲਾਲਨੁ; ਪਾਇਓ ਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੧੨੮॥
Sister, now I have found the beautiful Beloved, the Enchanter. Second Rahao ॥1॥128॥
ਮੋਰੀ ਅਹੰ ਜਾਇ; ਦਰਸਨ ਪਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
Beholding the Master, my ego has departed.
ਰਾਚਹੁ ਨਾਥ ਹੀ; ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਤਨਾ ॥ ਅਬ ਚਰਨ ਗਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Stay ever joined to the feet of the Master, the helper of the saints; I have now taken hold of His feet. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਆਹੇ ਮਨ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਭਾਵੈ, ਚਰਨਾਵੈ ਚਰਨਾਵੈ; ਉਲਝਿਓ ਅਲਿ. ਮਕਰੰਦ ਕਮਲ ਜਿਉ ॥
By His sight my mind likes nothing else and longs only for His feet; as the bumblebee clings to the pollen of the lotus, so my mind turns again and again to His feet.
ਅਨ ਰਸ. ਨਹੀ ਚਾਹੈ; ਏਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹੈ ॥੧॥
My mind does not want other relishes; it seeks the One Lord alone. ॥1॥
ਅਨ ਤੇ ਟੂਟੀਐ; ਰਿਖ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ ॥
By His sight, one breaks with attachment to other things and is freed from the grip of the senses.
ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਘੂਟੀਐ; ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਉਲਟੀਐ ॥
O mind, in the Guru's company the relish of the Lord's Name is drunk, and the mind turns back from attachment to Maya.
By His sight, no other attachment pleases at all.
Nanak, say: love for the Lord's feet alone remains at all times. ॥2॥2॥129॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
The Lord's Name destroys all pain; form kinship with that Name in your heart,
ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
remembering which Ajamal turned from vice and Ganika was freed from vice; you too keep kinship with the Lord's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਗਜ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟੀ ਛਿਨਹੂ ਮਹਿ; ਜਬ ਹੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਬਖਾਨੋ ॥
When the elephant uttered the Lord's Name, his peril too was removed in an instant.
ਨਾਰਦ ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਧ੍ਰੂਅ ਬਾਰਿਕ; ਭਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
Hearing Narad's teaching, the child Dhru became absorbed in the Lord's worship. ॥1॥
ਅਚਲ ਅਮਰ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਓ; ਜਗਤ ਜਾਹਿ ਹੈਰਾਨੋ ॥
Through worship of the Lord's Name, Dhru attained a spiritual state that became unshakeable and immortal for ever, and the world is amazed at him.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ. ਭਗਤ ਰਛਕ ਹਰਿ; ਨਿਕਟਿ ਤਾਹਿ. ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨੋ ॥੨॥੧॥
Nanak says: you too know the Lord to be ever near you; the Lord is the protector of His devotees. ॥2॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ; ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Without remembering the Lord's Name, a person keeps suffering pain.
ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ. ਸਹਸਾ. ਨਹ ਚੂਕੈ; ਗੁਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਬਤਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Guru tells this deep secret of life's path: without devotion to the Lord, a person's dread does not end. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਤੀਰਥ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਕੀਏ; ਰਾਮ ਸਰਨਿ. ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥
If a person does not take the Lord's refuge, of what use are his pilgrimages and fasts?
